thread:
Carmen (People Ops): Hey all — we've published a handbook update introducing a Conflict of Interest (COI) disclosure requirement and a short 20-min micro-course. Managers must confirm their teams have submitted disclosures and complete the manager module by Fri 2026-08-12.
Dmitri (Legal): Link to the revised section: https://handbook.internal/policies/conflict-of-interest. Legal reviewed; left one comment for contractor clause in JP.
Olivia (People Partner): Tracker is live: https://sheets.redwood/coi-acknowledgements. Managers: set "Team Verified" = Yes + date after verifying disclosures. Individual employees will submit via the form linked in the handbook.
Rae (Recruiting): For hiring: add "COI disclosure required" to the manager onboarding checklist and the offer pack for roles with procurement access. I'll update ATS templates.
DisclosureBot: Reminder: employees will receive an automated email with the disclosure form. Managers without "Team Verified" entries will get a DM reminder on Mon 2026-08-08 09:00 UTC.
Ari (Eng Manager): If someone's disclosure lists a potential conflict, what's the triage process?
Dmitri (Legal): Triage: manager flags the entry in the tracker, tags @Olivia + @Dmitri, and Legal will advise on mitigation steps within 3 business days. We added that flow to the handbook.
Carmen (People Ops): Admin tip for exports (admins only):
```
curl -s "https://people-tools/api/export?sheet=coi-acknowledgements" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PEOPLE_TOKEN" > coi_export.csv
```
Olivia (People Partner): If a manager is on leave, note it in the tracker and we'll temporarily reassign verification to the People Partner.
Rae (Recruiting): Noting: for interim/per diem managers under 30 days, they still need to complete the manager module or delegate verification.
Carmen (People Ops): Our goal is 100% verified teams for audit. I'll post a 1-slide summary and the compliance checklist in #management-resources later today. Ping me for per-team exports.
Dmitri (Legal): Final: disclosures are confidential and stored in the secure compliance folder; managers only see flag status and the mitigation note (no full disclosure text).
